senses.gloss: m. (κήλων) swipe and bucket for drawing water.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 1:1">M. Kat. I, 1</cite> <he>אין משקין … ולא ממי ק׳</he> during the festive week you must not water a field with rain water or with water drawn with the swipe; <cite ref="Tosefta Moed Kattan 1:1">Tosef. ib. I, 1</cite> <he>ואין ממלין הימנו בק׳</he> you must not draw water from it (the well) with the swipe; <he>אפי׳ … בק׳</he> not even from a pond which has been filled with buckets.

<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 4:9">Makhsh. IV, 9</cite> <he>הממלא בק׳ עד וכ׳</he> if one draws water with the swipe, up to three days the water remaining in the bucket makes things susceptible of uncleanness, Maim. (differently expl. in Ar. a. R. S.); Tosef. ib. II, 9.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 99b:4">B. Bath. 99ᵇ</cite> <he>בית הק׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>הקלון</he>, corr. acc.; Var. in comment. <he>הסילון</he>) a field irrigated by swipe and bucket; v. <cite ref="O00658"><he>סִילּוֹן</he> II</cite>.
